item.description:
Your photos are now searchable

Aura now recognizes what's in your images — entirely on your Mac, nothing leaves your device. Save a photo of your dog and search "dog"; save a sunset and search "sunset". Screenshots keep their text search too — recognition is added on top of OCR, not instead of it. Images you've already saved are upgraded automatically in the background.

JS-heavy links finally give up their content

Notion pages, Bluesky, and other client-rendered sites used to be searchable by title only — their pages look empty to a normal fetch. Aura now quietly renders those pages off-screen and indexes the real content, so you can find a saved Notion doc by what's written inside it. Regular articles still use the fast path; nothing about your library is ever sent anywhere.

Polish

  • Search hero — the "Ask your Memory…" placeholder stays visible until you type, and clicking anywhere dismisses the caret.

Quick Notes — jot straight into the notch

Press ⌃⌘N from anywhere and the notch opens a clean little writing space. Type your thought, press Return to save it to Aura, ⇧Return for a new line, Esc to dismiss. No window to find, no app to switch to — the note just lands in your library.

  • Global hotkey — ⌃⌘N works in any app (no Accessibility permission needed).
  • Or hover the notch — a new Note button opens the same composer.
  • Stays out of your way — focus returns to whatever you were doing the moment you save or dismiss.

A more delightful capture card

When you copy something, the “keep this?” card now blooms gently into place and eases back out — a smooth, bounce-free motion instead of a quick blink.

Calmer keep card

The keep card now drops straight down out of the notch, holds still for ~2.5 seconds, and slides straight back up — no more rubber-band bounce or stretch.

Snappier capture + auto-update on launch

  • Checks for updates when you open Aura — no need to use “Check for Updates…” manually.
  • Tighter card — less empty space above the keep card.
  • Quick peek — the card now slides down, lingers ~2.5s, and glides back into the notch. Hover it to keep it around.

The Keep card is back

When you copy something, the notch now slides a little “keep this?” card down automatically — with a clear Keep button — instead of just nudging. Click Keep to save it, ✕ to dismiss, or ignore it and it quietly retracts. Hovering the card pauses the countdown.
